Phase 3 — text-edit screenshot baseline
========================================

Deferred to Phase D1 (final integration + visual regression baseline).

Rationale: Phase 3 scope is the C++ regression-lock cycle for the three
reported user-bugs and surrounding P0 rows. Pixel-level UI-screenshot
work (UI-TE-UI-01..05 in tests/fixtures/ui_audit/UI_MATRIX_GAPS.md)
is consolidated in Phase D1 where the project-wide baseline is built
in a single deterministic session.

See README.md in this directory for the full deferral rationale.
